transcript.statement: The GreenAgent emphasizes the necessity of sustainability in the library management system. Requirements GRN-01, GRN-03, and GRN-07 focus on minimizing energy consumption and promoting digital solutions to reduce waste. GRN-02 and GRN-06 ensure accountability and track energy savings, while GRN-05 addresses responsible disposal of damaged books. transcript.statement: The TrustworthinessAgent emphasizes the necessity of security and privacy in the library management system. Requirements TRU-01 and TRU-03 ensure that only authenticated members can access borrowing features and that personal information is encrypted, safeguarding user data. However, I raise concerns about SAF-05, which may conflict with TRU-05 by potentially exposing sensitive information when revoking borrowing privileges. Additionally, EFF-01's response time requirement may hinder the implementation of robust security measures, impacting TRU-01 and TRU-03.

requirements.text: The system shall ensure that no member can borrow more than 5 books simultaneously.
The system shall automatically track and notify members of overdue books within 24 hours of the due date.
The system shall maintain real-time inventory status of all books to prevent double borrowing.
The system shall provide a backup mechanism to recover all transaction data in case of a failure.
The system shall implement a user authentication process to ensure only registered members can access borrowing features.
The system shall log all transactions, including borrow and return actions, for audit purposes.
The system shall enable searching for books with a response time of under 2 seconds for 95% of queries.
The system shall allow a maximum of 5 simultaneous book borrow operations per member.
The system shall process book returns within 1 second to maintain high throughput.
The system shall send overdue notifications to members within 24 hours of the due date to ensure accountability.
The system shall enable librarians to add or remove books with a latency of less than 3 seconds per operation.
The system shall maintain an uptime of 99.5% to ensure consistent availability for users.
The library management system shall minimize energy consumption by using energy-efficient servers and infrastructure.
The system shall provide an energy usage report for library operations at least quarterly.
The library management system shall enable digital notifications for overdue books to reduce paper waste.
The system shall implement a feedback mechanism for members to report issues or suggestions regarding fairness in library services.
The system shall provide an accessible interface for all users, including those with disabilities, to promote fairness and inclusivity.
The system shall ensure compliance with data protection regulations by implementing encryption for all member data.
The system shall allow members to update their personal information securely.
